# cursor-unison

> Persistent AI memory for Cursor — a plugin that connects every Cursor session
> to a hosted Unison brain: search context injected at session start, transcripts
> saved at session end, and 16 MCP tools for explicit memory control mid-session.

**Agents: start with [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)** — install, authenticate with a
`usk_` key, and verify the MCP wiring in under five minutes.

## Docs
- [README.md](README.md): install, quickstart, MCP tools, configuration reference
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): agent-focused guide — install, auth, MCP wiring, and contributing
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): build commands, conventions, PR process
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): how to report vulnerabilities

## Usage
- Set `UNISON_TOKEN=usk_live_...` and `UNISON_API_URL=https://brain.unisonlabs.ai`
- Install from the Cursor Marketplace, or run `bun run build` locally and point `.cursor/mcp.json` at `dist/mcp-server.js`
- CLI: `bunx cursor-unison@latest login --email you@example.com`
- MCP: 16 tools covering search, read/write, edit, delete, list, tag, grep, entity resolution, facts, graph traversal, config, and status

## Examples
- Authenticate: `bunx cursor-unison@latest login --email you@example.com`
- Recover a key: `bunx cursor-unison@latest login --email you@example.com --recover`
- Check status: `bunx cursor-unison@latest status`
- Start MCP server: `bunx cursor-unison@latest mcp`
